why_it_matters.zh: 长期 Agent 的价值来自跨月项目演化、偏好漂移与延迟后果，这些信号决定记忆是否持续帮助用户。
why_it_matters.en: Long-term agent value depends on project evolution, preference drift, and delayed consequences across months.

current_coverage.zh: DynamicMem、LifeSide 与 LoCoMo-Plus 已开始测量长期用户状态、伴随关系和隐式约束。
current_coverage.en: DynamicMem, LifeSide, and LoCoMo-Plus begin to measure sustained user state, companion dynamics, and implicit constraints.

next_coordinate.zh: 建立来自真实长期交互的可同意追踪协议，同时评估帮助程度、偏好漂移与延迟副作用。
next_coordinate.en: Build consented longitudinal protocols that jointly evaluate helpfulness, preference drift, and delayed side effects.

candidate_evaluation.zh: 按月切分项目历史，在保持权限边界的条件下测量状态恢复、行动收益和用户纠正成本。
candidate_evaluation.en: Split project histories by month and measure state recovery, action benefit, and user correction cost under explicit authority boundaries.

title.zh: 不可逆行动与动态权限

why_it_matters.zh: 当记忆驱动消费、状态改写或对外操作时，正确召回需要与权限时效和可恢复性共同评估。
why_it_matters.en: When memory drives spending, state changes, or external actions, correct recall must be evaluated with authority freshness and recoverability.

current_coverage.zh: GateMem、Mem2ActBench 与 PAST-Bench 分别覆盖权限、工具行动和跨任务因果效用。
current_coverage.en: GateMem, Mem2ActBench, and PAST-Bench cover authority, tool action, and cross-task causal utility.

next_coordinate.zh: 把权限变化、行动成本、回滚能力与记忆来源组合进同一可执行协议。
next_coordinate.en: Combine authority changes, action cost, reversibility, and memory provenance in one executable protocol.

candidate_evaluation.zh: 使用带预算和权限到期的沙箱任务，对成功行动、合规行动和恢复成本分别计分。
candidate_evaluation.en: Use sandbox tasks with budgets and expiring permissions, scoring task success, authorized behavior, and recovery cost separately.

why_it_matters.zh: 网页和知识库持续变化，稳定答案需要与版本兼容、证据新鲜度和反馈影响共同成立。
why_it_matters.en: Web and knowledge stores evolve continuously, so stable answers depend on version compatibility, evidence freshness, and feedback effects.

current_coverage.zh: EvoBrowseComp、Snapshot Compatibility Audit 与 KBGym 分别覆盖变化知识、快照兼容和可编辑知识库。
current_coverage.en: EvoBrowseComp, Snapshot Compatibility Audit, and KBGym cover evolving knowledge, snapshot compatibility, and editable knowledge stores.

next_coordinate.zh: 统一记录查询时刻、语料版本、索引状态与证据生命周期，形成可复现的持续评测。
next_coordinate.en: Record query time, corpus version, index state, and evidence lifecycle in a reproducible continuous evaluation.

candidate_evaluation.zh: 对同一问题进行跨快照重放，区分真实知识变化、检索漂移和生成随机性。
candidate_evaluation.en: Replay the same questions across snapshots and separate real knowledge change, retrieval drift, and generation variance.

why_it_matters.zh: 深度搜索的质量依赖多轮查询、工具和上下文管理，成本结构决定方案能否进入真实使用。
why_it_matters.en: Deep-search quality depends on repeated queries, tools, and context management; its cost structure determines practical adoption.

current_coverage.zh: The Commercial Tax、SearchAuditBench 与 LoHoSearch 已呈现部署成本、轨迹失效和长时程搜索压力。
current_coverage.en: The Commercial Tax, SearchAuditBench, and LoHoSearch expose deployment cost, trajectory failures, and long-horizon search pressure.

next_coordinate.zh: 并列报告答案质量、证据覆盖、工具调用、延迟、Token 与信息重获取成本。
next_coordinate.en: Report answer quality, evidence coverage, tool calls, latency, tokens, and information reacquisition cost side by side.

candidate_evaluation.zh: 在固定质量目标下比较 Pareto frontier，并保留完整轨迹用于失败和成本归因。
candidate_evaluation.en: Compare Pareto frontiers under a fixed quality target and retain complete trajectories for failure and cost attribution.

why_it_matters.zh: 可执行 SQL 仍可能违背业务定义；可靠 Data Agent 需要同时理解口径、主动澄清并交付可核验结果。
why_it_matters.en: Executable SQL can still violate business definitions; reliable data agents must understand semantics, clarify intent, and deliver verifiable results.

current_coverage.zh: WarehouseReliabilityBench、Spider 2.0 与 Data Exploration Benchmark 分别覆盖可靠应答、复杂数据库任务和分析前数据理解。
current_coverage.en: WarehouseReliabilityBench, Spider 2.0, and Data Exploration Benchmark cover reliable response behavior, complex database work, and pre-analysis data understanding.

next_coordinate.zh: 把业务真值、澄清质量、SQL 执行和交付物一致性放入同一端到端协议。
next_coordinate.en: Join business ground truth, clarification quality, SQL execution, and deliverable consistency in one end-to-end protocol.

candidate_evaluation.zh: 使用带版本和歧义标注的指标目录，由隐藏业务规则验证查询、解释和拒答选择。
candidate_evaluation.en: Use a versioned metric catalog with ambiguity annotations and hidden business rules to verify queries, explanations, and abstention choices.

why_it_matters.zh: Agent 提升模型分数时，需要区分真实算法改进、实验搜索收益和对评测协议的适配。
why_it_matters.en: When agents improve model scores, evaluation must distinguish algorithmic improvement, search gains, and adaptation to the evaluation protocol.

current_coverage.zh: MLE-bench、DeltaML-Bench 与 AI4AI-Bench 已把真实仓库、基线提升和 clean-start 验证纳入协议。
current_coverage.en: MLE-bench, DeltaML-Bench, and AI4AI-Bench incorporate real repositories, baseline improvement, and clean-start verification.

next_coordinate.zh: 建立跨仓库、跨预算的改进归因协议，同时记录实验轨迹、源码变化和最终复现。
next_coordinate.en: Build cross-repository, cross-budget attribution protocols that preserve experiment trajectories, source changes, and final reproduction.

candidate_evaluation.zh: 固定算力与数据访问，分别评分研究假设、实验效率、最终提升和 clean-start 可复现性。
candidate_evaluation.en: Fix compute and data access, then score research hypotheses, experiment efficiency, final improvement, and clean-start reproducibility separately.
